desc: Implement reading input and storing the grid $A$.
Compute the $Down$ DP table where $Down[h][w]$ is the sum of path products from $(1,1)$ to $(h,w)$.
Compute the $Up$ DP table where $Up[h][w]$ is the sum of path products from $(h,w)$ to $(H,W)$.
Calculate the initial total sum using the formula $\sum Pre[h][w] A_{h,w} Suf[h][w]$.
Process each query: update the total sum using the delta of $A_{r,c}$ and the precomputed $Pre[r][c], Suf[r][c]$, update $A_{r,c}$, and print the result.
